name: B24U Chat Widget
author: GLOBERINT PTE. LTD.

sections.description:
B24U is an AI chat assistant for websites, developed and operated by Globerint Pte. Ltd. (Singapore), the publisher of this plugin. The plugin adds the B24U chat widget to the public pages of your WordPress site and connects your site to B24U.

  • Connect your site to B24U from the plugin settings in one step.
  • All widget settings (appearance, texts, behaviour) are managed in your B24U account.
  • The widget script loads asynchronously and never blocks your pages.
  • Optional local overrides: popup text, photo and button position for this site only.

Free start and plans. Every new site gets 7 days free: the chat answers visitors, up to 10 leads. A lead is one visitor who left a name, email or phone in the chat; requests with the same email, phone or visitor count as one lead. After the trial you choose a paid plan; the price depends on your site and the number of leads.

Your dashboard. Leads, chats, analytics and the chat settings are at my.b24u.com (my.b24u.ru for the Russian zone). You sign in with a link sent to your email, or open it from the plugin settings.

External services

This plugin relies on the B24U service (https://b24u.com), operated by Globerint Pte. Ltd. Without a B24U account for your site the plugin shows nothing on your pages.

What is loaded and sent, and when:

  • On every public page, while the widget is enabled: the browser of the visitor loads the widget script from https://i.b24u.com/<your domain> (or https://i.b24u.ru/<your domain> if your B24U account is on b24u.ru). The widget then opens the chat and sends to B24U what the visitor types into the chat, together with page and visit analytics (page address, referrer, time on page, clicks on the chat). Nothing is loaded when the widget is disabled in the plugin settings.
  • In the WordPress admin, on the plugin settings page and on the first page view after the domain is changed: your server requests https://i.b24u.ru/<your domain> and https://i.b24u.com/<your domain> to find which B24U server knows your site. Only the domain is sent.
  • When you press “Connect B24U”: a B24U sign-up page opens (b24u.ru for Russian-language sites, b24u.com for the rest) in a new window with your site address and a verification code filled in. While the code exists, the plugin prints <meta name="b24u-site-verification"> with it on your pages, so that B24U can confirm you run the site. You enter your contact details on the B24U page yourself.

B24U Terms of Service: https://partner.b24u.com/docs/en/legal/terms-of-service-eu
B24U Privacy Policy: https://partner.b24u.com/docs/en/legal/privacy-policy-eu
For accounts on b24u.ru: https://b24u.ru/documents
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory and activate it.
  2. Open Settings > B24U Chat.
  3. If your site is not connected to B24U yet, press “Connect B24U” and finish the sign-up. The chat appears on your site right after.
sections.faq:
Do I need a B24U account?

Yes. The plugin shows the chat of your B24U account. Press “Connect B24U” in the plugin settings to create one for your site.

Is it free?

The plugin is free. Every new site gets 7 days of B24U free (up to 10 leads); after that the B24U service has paid plans, the price depends on your site and the number of leads.

What is a lead?

One visitor who left a name, email or phone in the chat. Requests with the same email, phone or visitor count as one lead.

Where do I see leads and chats?

In your B24U dashboard: my.b24u.com (my.b24u.ru for the Russian zone). You sign in with a link sent to your email, or open it from Settings > B24U Chat.

Who publishes this plugin?

Globerint Pte. Ltd., the company that develops and operates B24U.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Settings page is translatable; Russian translation included.
  • Russian-language sites sign up and manage the widget on b24u.ru, other sites on b24u.com.

1.1.0

  • Scripts are added with wp_enqueue_script and wp_add_inline_script (async), no inline script tags.
  • Settings input is unslashed and sanitized; settings page checks the user capability.
  • readme: external services section, publisher, requirements.

1.0.5

  • Connect B24U from the plugin settings: a site that is not a B24U client yet registers in one step

1.0.4

  • Domain and server preset by the B24U panel download (b24u-defaults.json)

1.0.3

  • Widget server picked per domain (i.b24u.ru or i.b24u.com); before, RU domains got an empty widget

1.0.2

  • Shorter embed: one inline line for early clicks, no init() call

1.0.1

  • Async loading: inline stub + async script, the page never waits for the widget

1.0.0

  • Initial release
